text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ACME partner wants a small co-marketing push: 45m webinar + short benchmark blog + marketplace connector listing. Need a compact playbook for demo pipeline, landing page, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?

aj: I can lead webinar ops. Proposed date: Tue Apr 7 or Thu Apr 9. Prefer Apr 7 10am PT. Can we lock that?

maria: Apr 7 10am PT works for customer. aj please own invites, runbook, and MC.

kevin: I’ll take marketplace listing metadata + connector copy. Need final integration screenshots and a 2-line value prop by EOD Fri.

ellie: I’ll draft the benchmark blog and short results blurb. Want access to the demo dataset and perf numbers by Mon.

priya: I’ll handle inbound lead routing and tracking — HubSpot -> SFDC mapping. Quick question: do we want partner leads to go to Partner SDR queue or Product demo queue?

maria: send partner leads to Partner SDR first, then route to Product demo if qualified. Priya, please set UTM tagging and a lead source = "ACME_webinar".

priya: On routing — here’s the minimal hidden-fields + webhook payload I recommend. Use the landing form and include partner tags so ACME-sourced leads are flagged for co-marketing reporting.

priya: ```
// HubSpot hidden fields on registration form
utm_source: "acme_partner"
utm_medium: "webinar"
lead_source: "ACME_webinar"
partner_account: "acme-inc"
route_to_queue: "partner-sdr"
// webhook sample POST to /hooks/marketing/lead-ingest
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{firstname}}",
  "last_name": "{{lastname}}",
  "tags": ["acme","webinar","connector"],
  "source": "ACME_webinar"
}
```

aj: Nice. For the landing page can we re-use the ACME demo screenshot + 1-min video clip? I’ll wireframe and share by Tue.

kevin: I’ll produce the connector screenshot set today — export at 1200px and 800px. Also will draft the 2-line value prop: "Redwood + ACME: low-latency inference for cloud data sources, listed on ACME Exchange." Feedback?

ellie: Fine, tweak to include a number if we have it: e.g., "30% lower p95 latency on common prompts" — need numbers from infra.

samir: Legal/compliance quick note — put a small data-responsibility blurb on the landing page and the marketplace listing: "No customer data used outside demo infra; credentials not stored." I’ll draft boilerplate.

maria: Good call. ops-bot can we create a shared doc and calendar event?

ops-bot: Created doc https://redwoodhq.app/marketing/acme/co-marketing-playbook and calendar event "ACME joint webinar — prep" Apr 7 10:00 PT.

aj: Thanks — I’ll post the run-of-show in the doc and assign rehearsal slots (Wed Apr 1, Thu Apr 2).

priya: One more detail on reporting: add a utm_campaign tag = "acme_connector_q2" and set a lead custom field "partner_program" = "marketplace_integrations". I’ll add the exact HubSpot field names in the doc.

kevin: Re: co-branded assets — do we have signed logo guidelines from ACME? If not, can someone ping their PM?

maria: I asked ACME PM earlier today for logo kit and co-branding guide. If we don’t have it by Fri, use the mono logo fallback and markup to be approved by samir.

ellie: Timeline check — milestone list for internal ops:
- Today: kevin exports screenshots
- Fri EOD: kevin value prop + logo confirmation
- Mon: infra numbers to ellie
- Tue: aj wireframe + draft landing page
- Wed/Thu rehearsals
- Apr 7: Webinar + demo
- Apr 9: Publish benchmark blog + marketplace listing (soft launch)

aj: I’ll own post-webinar follow-up email + CTA to marketplace listing. Priya, please provide the UTM'd URLs for the CTA in advance.

priya: Will deliver UTM'd URLs and HubSpot form embed snippet by Tue morning. Also creating a short internal Slack alert flow for Partner SDRs on new registrations: `#partner-sdrs` ping with lead summary (name, company, qual notes).

maria: Awesome — last ask: can each owner drop a single line in the doc today confirming they picked the item? Helps the ACME PM and our execs see owners.

kevin: Confirmed — I own listing + screenshots + value prop.

ellie: Confirmed — I’ll write the benchmark and get infra numbers Monday.

aj: Confirmed — I own webinar ops + runbook + rehearsal scheduling.

priya: Confirmed — I own lead routing, UTM tracking, and SDR alerts.

samir: Confirmed — I’ll send the compliance blurb and approve co-branding fallback.

maria: Perfect. Keeping this thread as the single-source for quick clarifications. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :raised_hands:
